svg.aria-label: Istio PQC mTLS benchmark, B.Sc. thesis. Measures the CPU and latency cost of mTLS in Istio: TLS 1.2 vs 1.3, and classical X25519 vs hybrid post-quantum X25519MLKEM768. Each configuration is forced with an EnvoyFilter and verified from Envoy statistics on every run. Status: Now: Analysis. 17-hour measurement campaign complete
